note: Seeded distributions until live aggregates exist. Stable per puzzle id. firstGuessWorld / firstGuessByCountry are first submits (not final answers). countryBoard is average tries only; countries under 20 plays are skipped in the UI, and the board is ranked by fewest tries. standing.byTries is finished games; standing.failed is unfinished games, ranked below every finish. Accuracy starts at 100 and drops by the normalized rank distance of each imperfect guess. The crowd sits a little under a typical clear, with a real spread. US and TW first-guess buckets are large enough to show; SG is under the 20-play threshold.
